title: Lena and the Echo
author: Ada Sandoval
blurb: Emrys Coldharbour, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
